observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: outdoor lawn in daylight, festive or ceremonial occasion with tents and seated guests in the background
observation.dancers: mixed group of men and women, appearing to be young adults, performing together and taking turns
observation.formation_and_space: fluid group formation on grass, dancers moving around each other and varying positions between standing, kneeling, and sitting
observation.posture: upright torso with deep knee bends and forward leans during energetic sections, weight shifting dynamically
observation.footwork: fast stomping and lifting steps on the beat, low jumps, and leg extensions while seated or kneeling; exact foot placement details obscured by grass and distance

observation.hips_and_torso: torso bobs and leans with knee bends, occasional drops to the ground and hip swivels while seated
observation.partnering: solo and group dancing with no close physical contact between partners
observation.levels_jumps_turns: frequent level changes between standing, crouching, kneeling, and sitting on the ground; energetic jumps and low kicks from seated positions
observation.costume_and_props: men wear white tank tops, trousers with yellow and red sashes, brown hats, bead necklaces, and decorative bell-like leg wraps over dark boots; women wear bright pink draped dresses over yellow skirts with headbands; props include long walking sticks and brown cloths held by men
